packageRules.description: GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks never reach the published tarball, so updating one must never release. The actions scope matches the shared release rule {type: chore, scope: actions, release: false} for patch, minor and major alike; without it a major bump arrives as chore(deps)!, which releases a major.

devDependencies never reach consumers, so updating one must never release. The literal prefix is needed because the shared preset's major rule sets commitMessagePrefix 'chore(deps)!: ', which a packageRule can only override, not unset; 'chore(actions)' maps to release: false in @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config. The separate group keeps dev updates out of groups that also hold runtime dependencies, whose PR title would otherwise decide the release for both.
pre-commit hook majors: the shared preset restores the 'chore(actions): ' prefix for github-actions majors only, so without this a hook major still arrives as 'chore(deps)!: ' and releases a major.
